يحق (form I)
# يَحِقُّ (yaḥiqqu) /ja.ħiq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحُقُّ (yaḥuqqu) /ja.ħuq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحِقَّ (yaḥiqqa) /ja.ħiq.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحُقَّ (yaḥuqqa) /ja.ħuq.qa/: third-person mascu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
